instruction: The init file is located at C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. You need to open it yourself before doing the task. Two Storey Classroom Retrofit IFC And Revit Room Schedule CSV This task starts from init.ifc and uses the local reference image init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a two-storey classroom layout, export the model as result.ifc, and export a Revit room area schedule as result.csv in the Desktop. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc and result.csv; result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and result.csv is at least 20 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 5 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, and 2 IfcStair entities. 5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. 6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token classroom at least 4 times and support at least once. 7. Result.csv is a Revit room schedule export with exactly the headers Room Name,Area in that order and exactly 5 non-empty data rows. 8. Result.csv contains these exact room name and area rows: Classroom 1=26.0, Classroom 2=26.0, Classroom 3=26.0, Classroom 4=26.0, and Support Room=36.0. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
